title: Comfort Card
user: Players with motion sickness who need a fast, game-specific checklist of visual settings to try before spending an hour becoming nauseated.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA that creates a per-game comfort card: symptom triggers, ordered settings to try, 15-minute check-ins, and a shareable non-identifying card.
constraints: Use careful non-medical language; all records local by default; do not imply that settings make a game safe for every user; allow immediate stop guidance.
